title: Elixir of Barkskin
summary: Until Long Rest, use the higher of AC 16 and your usual AC after modifiers.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, use the higher of AC 16 and your usual AC after modifiers.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other normal elixirs and can be overwritten by another.
fields.Crafting: Combine Salts of Tree Bark with any Suspension.
fields.AC interaction: Apply other AC adjustments before selecting the higher value, so a +2 adjustment does not necessarily create AC 18.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
